model_code = r'''
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def model(regime, n, seed):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    T = float(regime.config.get("T", 1.0))

    # Mean purity vs temperature: fitted quadratic from observed lot data
    a, b, c = -6.14473013, 11.24333356, 87.02807175
    mu = a*T*T + b*T + c

    # Heteroskedastic lot-to-lot SD via quadratic fit on log variance
    va, vb, vc = 0.32524441, -1.86527385, 2.72019161
    log_var = va*T*T + vb*T + vc
    sigma = float(np.sqrt(np.exp(log_var)))
    sigma = max(sigma, 1e-6)

    # Small low-purity contamination / upset component; more likely away from optimum
    p_bad = 0.03 + 0.08 * min(1.0, abs(T - 1.0) / 0.4)
